adda247.product: Competitive-exam preparation platform: web, Android, iOS and iPad
adda247.service: UX research, product design, design system, mobile app design
adda247.problem: A platform that grew module by module needed one coherent learning experience across tests, live classes, dashboards and community.
adda247.outcome: Redesigned modules including the test-series engine, live classes, performance dashboards, community and native iOS/iPad apps.

kelp-global.product: Private-markets software: deals module, inbox plugin, Truenorth investor portal
kelp-global.service: SaaS product design, data-dense UI, design system
kelp-global.problem: Deal teams kept company summaries, notes and documents in decks and inboxes, and investors had no single place for fund documents.
kelp-global.outcome: Three connected products designed on one shared design system.

betacrew.product: Portle, a developer-first API management platform
betacrew.service: Product design, developer UX, white-label design system
betacrew.problem: Developers managed APIs across three disconnected tools for design, testing and documentation, so documentation drifted out of date.
betacrew.outcome: One platform replacing three tools, with a white-label theming system for enterprise deployments.

rcentric.product: Luxury property websites for seven Dubai developments
rcentric.problem: Each property launch needed a premium digital experience without starting from scratch every time.
rcentric.outcome: Seven property experiences delivered on a shared system that kept each launch distinct.
rcentric.alt: Anwa Aria luxury property website by Designit

tata-elxsi.product: In-car infotainment system and digital instrument cluster
tata-elxsi.problem: In-car interfaces where every glance is attention taken from the road, inside a tier-one supplier's hardware constraints.
tata-elxsi.outcome: Two HMI systems designed: an infotainment interface and a digital instrument cluster.
